approvers: My bank, my tax adviser and lawyer, and my wife and staff informally
reason: I'd give a free first meeting because the staff, name and location guarantees are what I care about, and the bank letter is a good start. But they have no earlier sellers and I have no successor yet, so I'd check them thoroughly and take my time; this is my life's work.
objection: They have no track record and no seller I can call. If it goes wrong after I've handed over, my staff and my name pay for it, not me.
instead: Keep looking for a successor in the family or among my staff, and list the business quietly on nexxt-change to see who else comes.
would_change_my_mind: A reference from a seller they have already bought from, or a named owner I can phone, plus the staff and name guarantees written into the contract as enforceable terms.
